name: Stowe
terrain_source: USGS 3DEP 1 m LiDAR DEM, VT_Statewide_A23 (public domain)
extra_note: Main Street Race is the race lane beside the Sensation Quad (the one of OpenStreetMap's two 'Main Street' lines nearer the lift). Football Fields is drawn from the trail map beside Lower Main Street: approximate.
shared_runs_note: OpenStreetMap starts Upper Toll Road along Ridgeview from the Cliff House for about 300 m (two lines 5-11 m apart): Ridgeview keeps that stretch, which also carries the Toll Road's name, and Upper Toll Road starts where it leaves it (2026-11-23).
